result:
**Bottom line:** send one short email now asking for three things: mailboxes, social accounts, and spend caps. Hold price, tax and merchant policy until I11 activation and L0. They don't block any sandbox proof, and asking now would push Shakur to pick numbers before there's evidence behind them.

I only read files. I didn't run the Python wrapper or write `opus-owner-gates.json`; your script does that.

## What only Shakur can supply

| Area | Owner-only input | Agents decide |
|---|---|---|
| G-mail (P5) | Which two mailboxes and a calendar he controls and consents to test on. Permission for them to be OAuth test users. The exact recipients (those two mailboxes only). A numeric send cap. | Scopes, the adapter, how replies are matched, and keeping the OAuth app in Testing mode |
| G-social (P3) | Which accounts may be used as test identities for the five channels. Developer app registration where the platform needs a legal person or business verification (probably Meta and TikTok, likely LinkedIn for company pages). Any paid API tier (X may charge; check its current terms, don't assume). Allowed post visibility and content. | Postiz vs Post for Me, the channel matrix, the test post text within his approved rule, and how scheduling and cancellation are designed |
| G-platform (I2) | Yes or no, plus a numeric monthly cap, for Convex Pro, hosting, backup and alerts | Which backup and alert providers to use, how previews work, the CI design |
| G-runtime (P6) | Funding account and numeric caps per run, per workspace and globally. Or an explicit "zero, stay on stub" | The executor, the isolation design, and how caps are enforced |
| I11 / G-pay (later) | Real price, free tier or not, refunds, tax, merchant jurisdiction, readonly collection | The sandbox fixture price, clearly labeled as a fixture, and the full test-clock matrix |

## What can move forward now without Shakur (SIM/SANDBOX/DESK only, no spend)

- **P6:** everything except the one real-model smoke check. That means the stub model, isolation attacks, atomic budget reservation and kill switch. The runtime is reported as SERVICE/SIM and hosted adoption stays blocked.
- **I11:** all of r7 cases 1–12 in the isolated Stripe sandbox with a placeholder price labeled `FIXTURE, not owner price`.
- **P4:** two Connect sandbox connected accounts, marked "jurisdiction pending owner".
- **P3:** candidate inspection, licences, API and review requirements from primary sources, and a local Postiz install with SIM posts. No real posting.
- **P5:** finish the OAuth app in Testing mode, plus the SIM fault tests: revoke, replay, forged watch notifications, and the reply/unsubscribe race.
- **I2:** anything that runs on free tiers or locally. Anything that needs paid previews, backup or alerts waits for the spend answer. Check each free-tier limit from its own source; don't assume it.

## Draft email

**To/From:** shakur@codemyvibe.com
**Subject:** need your input

> Remold is moving on everything that runs in sandboxes. Four answers unblock the real-account proofs. One line each is fine.
>
> 1. **Test mailboxes.** Which two Google mailboxes (plus one calendar) do you control for testing? They only email each other, up to ___ messages a day, and nothing goes to anyone else. OK?
> 2. **Social test accounts.** For TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and X: which accounts can we post from, and will you register the developer apps where the platform asks for your ID or business verification? Test posts would be private or only-me where the platform allows it and deleted afterwards. Where a platform can't post privately, the text will be: "____". OK?
> 3. **Hosting spend.** Convex Pro, hosting, backups and alerts: approve up to $___ a month, or keep it at zero for now?
> 4. **AI model spend.** One real test run needs a funded provider account. Cap per run $___, per month $___, or keep it at zero and stay on the stub?
>
> Already decided, no action needed: tools, providers under your caps, test content within your rule, and how everything is built. Price, tax and refund policy come later, before billing goes live, with evidence attached.

Leave the blanks for Shakur to fill. Don't propose numbers for him. If he doesn't answer a cap, treat it as zero, as the pack already says.
